finding.title: Unconditional Arbiter Release and Post-Deadline Beneficiary Claim Bypass Active Dispute Cooling-Off Window in OphirPay Escrow
finding.impactStatement: In contracts/ophirpay/src/contract.rs:2314-2398, release_by_arbiter transfers 100% of escrowed tokens immediately without enforcing the 86,400-second dispute cooling-off window after open_dispute, and claim_escrow allows the beneficiary to drain disputed funds at t >= deadline (1,001,001) while an active dispute opened at t = 1,000,500 is still pending.
